valuationInputs.name: Cost of equity
valuationInputs.reason: CAPM from scripts/reinvestment.py: 8.24% + beta 1.22 × (4.2% + 6.08%), ±1.5 points. Replaces the hand-set 18/16.5/15%.

valuationInputs.name: EPS to March 2027 × P/E
valuationInputs.reason: Half-year loss Rs 4.81 already booked (Rs 2.89 last year); second half Rs 9.50 / 11.50 / 13.50 against Rs 12.06 last year as finance costs rise. Base 27% below 2025/26 EPS for that reason; 7% below trailing Rs 7.24. P/E now from the formula at the cost of equity instead of a hand-set 7/9/11x.

valuationInputs.name: NAV multiple
valuationInputs.reason: Unchanged: ROE below the cost of equity for a decade.

valuationInputs.name: Methods used
valuationInputs.value: NAV multiple, justified P/E, justified price to book
valuationInputs.reason: DCF dropped until the annual report's depreciation, operating profit and interest paid are recorded (whole-company DCF at WACC needs them). Residual income left out as before; dividend too small for a dividend model.

valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 20 Nov 2026. (1) Business: a hotel owner-operator (Maldives, Sri Lanka, Oman, India), one segment. (2) Damodaran's emerging-markets dataset (betaEmerg) could not be opened: his site is blocked by this run's network settings. Stand-in from a web-search extract of his global sector table (date not shown): Hotel/Gaming unlevered beta corrected for cash 0.66. (3) Relevered with net debt Rs 49.81bn (30 Sep 2026, borrowings Rs 40.96bn + leases Rs 22.35bn − cash and deposits Rs 13.50bn) ÷ equity at market value Rs 41.13bn (Rs 84.00 × 336.29mn shares = Rs 28.25bn, plus non-controlling interests at book Rs 12.88bn, because the group's debt carries the minorities' share too) = 1.21, tax 30% (standard rate; the half-year's effective rate is meaningless on a loss): 0.66 × (1 + 0.7 × 1.21) = 1.22. Without the minorities it would be 1.47. (4) Local 5-year betas: none found (web search 20 Nov 2026; TradingView shows only a 1-year beta of 0.87, ignored). Fewer than 3 sources, so step 4 can't be completed. (5) Higher of 1.22 and (no local figure) = 1.22. (6) Within 0.3–2. (7) Into the formula by scripts/reinvestment.py. Provisional: refresh in January 2027 with Damodaran's emerging-markets file and three verified local 5-year betas.

valuationInputs.name: WACC
valuationInputs.reason: scripts/reinvestment.py: debt weight 63.8% (net debt Rs 49.81bn, market cap Rs 28.25bn), cost of debt 12.24% (bond yield; 2025/26 interest paid not recorded), tax 30%. Not used while there's no DCF.

valuationInputs.name: Growth check
valuationInputs.value: Assumed 2% / 3% / 4% (long run); supported 11.3% (share of profit kept × ROE, 2025/26). All within 2 pts.
valuationInputs.reason: Capex-based check not possible: 2025/26 depreciation and operating profit not recorded (annual report not in this run).

valuationInputs.name: Long-run ROE (price to book)
valuationInputs.reason: Ten-year ROE mostly 2–6%, 10.2% and 11.6% in the last two years, about 8% trailing.

Annual report 2026/27 (or /redo full with the 2025/26 annual report): record depreciation, operating profit, interest paid, capex booked and tax rate so the whole-company DCF can be rebuilt.
Does the Rs 0.8bn hotel refurbishment from the debenture get spent, and on which properties?
Does the amount due from the holding company (Rs 4.26bn at September, up from Rs 2.0bn) come back in cash?

changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/add AHUN.N0000 SPEN.N0000; AHUN already covered, so handled as an update). Read the interim to 30 Sep 2026: half-year loss Rs 4.81 a share (Rs 2.89), Maldives/Middle East loss before tax Rs 1.99bn (Rs 0.74bn), net debt Rs 49.8bn (Rs 41.8bn in March), Rs 5bn debenture issued. Applied the current brief: beta 1.22 and CAPM cost of equity 20.8% (was a hand-set 16.5%); P/E and P/B from scripts/valuation.py; old shareholder-cash DCF dropped because the whole-company DCF needs 2025/26 annual-report figures not in this run (depreciation, operating profit, interest paid). Added requiredReturn, modelInputs, management (debenture plan only) and shareholders. Business tests still 1/4, category 3. Fair value Rs 69.50 → 41.31, buy 59.00 → 35.12, strong buy 52.10 → 30.98.
